title: Concept: File access built from input (r) — review required
description: In r, readLines(paste0(dir, f)) builds a file path from input, so traversal sequences can step outside the intended directory. The remedy is confinement to a base directory (normalized prefix check) plus normalization and an allowlist.
applicability: r file access; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write; HIGH severity.
